standard_prerequisites.name: Criterion for fibred in groupoids
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-fibred-groupoids, cited at proof lines 7681 and 7689-7690
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies (a) that every morphism of A is strongly B-cartesian and (b) the groupoid criterion restated in terms of fibre groupoids.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibred over fibred is fibred
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that A is fibred over C, reducing the claim to the groupoid property of the fibres A_U.

standard_prerequisites.name: Strongly cartesian morphisms with invertible image are invertible
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that a strongly B-cartesian morphism whose image in B is an isomorphism is itself an isomorphism.

core_obligations: 经 lemma-fibred-over-fibred 得 A 在 C 上纤维化，余下只须证每根纤维 A_U 是群胚（7680-7684 行）。
取 A_U 中态射 x→y：其在 B 中像是 B_U（群胚）中的同构（7685-7687 行）。
由每条态射强 B-笛卡尔 + lemma-composition-cartesian 得 x→y 为同构（7688-7690 行）。
proof_roadmap: 声明改用 lemma-fibred-groupoids 判据而非直接验证定义（7680-7681 行）。

群胚性：像同构 + 强笛卡尔性 ⇒ 同构（7685-7690 行）。
